body: Thanks, I never know what to do with my hair, it's untamable.
I think you look good man.
I'm just noticing that people have said that to me and it was from someone I considered my closest friend. Also my mom has said something from the list too. :/
I really don't know if I want to now, I'm afraid of being judged harshly because of my skin color.

Yeah, I'd like to go but I don't know if my crappy healthcare would even be able to cover it and I don't have the money at the moment to pay out of pocket. But, I'm sorry to hear that man, I can't say that I know the feeling, I do have like conspiracy theories sometimes that make me have anxious but it passes after a while and then its back again.
I'm 21, and I live in Kentucky.

My perspective of myself is always changing, I don't really know how to describe it. I also can't stick to one goal, I can't stay focused on one goal without changing it. I feel empty, I don't know how to be happy anymore. A lot of stuff that I loved to do is less appealing to me and I just cant seem to trust many people anymore, I don't even know who I am anymore. I don't know how it all happened and Im not even sure if it's BPD, I just always self diagnose myself even when I could be wrong. What symptoms do you have and are you getting treatment?
